HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen stands at the edge of the encampment, looking toward the mausoleum where an old friend rests.

description_variants.description: An Isolan stands at the edge of the encampment, looking toward the mausoleum where an old friend rests.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) had a friend who left the camp years ago to live with the tribe. They stopped speaking after that, not out of anger, just the way people drift. Word reached the camp that the friend has since died and rests in the tribe's mausoleum. Today (name1) is standing at the edge of the encampment, looking toward it.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) walks over in the quiet of the afternoon. Nobody stops (him/her). (He/she) stands among the graves for a long time, not sure which one is the right one, and decides it doesn't much matter. On the way back (he/she) realises (he/she) has forgotten to be nervous.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) sits on a rock where (he/she) can just see the mausoleum roof, and talks to (his/her) old friend from there. It feels like the right distance. They were always better at talking across a little space.
